definitions.explanation: Any of several small dragonflies whose bodies turn red in autumn, above all the autumn darter (アキアカネ). A classic image of the Japanese autumn.

examples.japanese: {赤蜻蛉|あかとんぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{赤蜻蛉|あかとんぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Red dragonflies become common in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{赤蜻蛉|あかとんぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧になって⟦{飛|と}んでいた→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Red dragonflies were flying in swarms across the sunset sky.

notes:
The red dragonflies come down from the mountains to the rice fields in early autumn, and they are one of the season's standard images in haiku and song. Usually written {赤|あか}とんぼ; the full kanji ⟦{蜻蛉|とんぼ}→蜻蛉：05204_tonbo⟧ is hard to read.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{赤|あか}とんぼ is also the title of a children's song (lyrics by {三木露風|みきろふう}, 1921; music by {山田耕筰|やまだこうさく}, 1927) that almost every Japanese person knows, beginning ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧{小焼|こや}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{赤|あか}とんぼ.

RELATED WORDS:
- とんぼ: dragonfly
- ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧: seasonal word in haiku ({赤|あか}とんぼ marks autumn)
